description: Atlyn Distribution compares grouped raw observations at a glance. It renders box plots with Hyndman-Fan Type 7 quartiles, Tukey 1.5xIQR inlier whiskers, mean markers, and genuine outliers. Transparent diagnostics report received, rendered, invalid, and dropped rows so report authors can see when a host window may be partial. The visual works offline, requires Category, Sample, and Value, and includes accessible summaries, selection, highlighting, localization, right-to-left layouts, high contrast, and reduced-motion support.
